note: machine_read_permit rows (Governance ruling 2026-11-10 20:24Z). A permit reopens a source whose robots.txt answers 401/403/429/451 (ROBOTS_REFUSED) and NOTHING else: never a Disallow, never an unreachable robots.txt. It quotes the publisher's own clause from doc_url; the Auditor checks the quote against the live page before CLEAR. The fetch uses the collector's honest agent, the documented endpoint and the source's own key; if the data endpoint itself refuses or rate-limits, that pass falls back to ROBOTS_REFUSED with no retry. A row with active=false is recorded and does nothing. Keyed by source id; derived sources (<id>__ep<hash>) inherit their parent's permit. Code-side on purpose: desks/mt5/data/ is box state.

eia_energy.clause: You may use the EIA API to develop a service to search, display, analyze, retrieve, view and otherwise "get" information from EIA data.
eia_energy.licence: US government work, public domain: 'U.S. government publications are in the public domain and are not subject to copyright protection.' (https://www.eia.gov/about/copyrights_reuse.php)
eia_energy.rate_limit: EIA's terms, 'Right to Limit': exceeding or circumventing the limits gets a key blocked; the collector asks once per weekly cadence, and a 429 on the data endpoint stops the pass (robots_gate.data_refused), never a retry
